title: Correlated Gaussian basis
label: Correlated basis
question: Can rotated local Gaussian components improve thin and curved shapes?
method: Extend the learned Gaussian basis with a bounded correlation per component, allowing full positive-definite 2D covariance. Use 384 components per class plus the same compact modulated MLP correction. No target geometry is used; the velocity loss and Heun sampler are unchanged.
finding: New best: 50/100 passed, up from 46/100 in EXP-008 and 39/100 in EXP-011. Mean SW1 also improves to 0.02782. Several remaining spiral, star and wave classes narrowly fail precision, motivating a density-consistent velocity model.
